from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_fft, sdh_onset
from scipy.signal import find_peaks

r6 = run(6)
ch6 = resolve_channels(r6.meta)
ic6 = current_channel(ch6)
vc6 = next(ch for ch in ch6 if ch.cid == 'sr1')
B6 = r6.col('magnet_field')
I6 = r6.col_at(ic6.idx) / ic6.gain
R6 = (r6.col_at(vc6.idx) / vc6.gain) / I6

fig, axs = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(9, 8), sharex=True)
axs[0].plot(B6, R6, lw=0.8); axs[0].set_ylabel('Rxx (Ω)'); axs[0].set_title('data/6 raw channels, B₁–B₂')
axs[1].plot(B6, I6*1e9, label='drain current'); axs[1].plot(B6, r6.col('T_sample'), label='T sample (K)'); axs[1].legend(); axs[1].set_ylabel('nA / K')
axs[2].plot(B6, r6.col('k_2400_tg_curr')*1e12, label='TG'); axs[2].plot(B6, r6.col('k_2400_bg_curr')*1e12, label='BG'); axs[2].legend(); axs[2].set_ylabel('gate current (pA)'); axs[2].set_xlabel('B (T)')
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(f'data/6: {r6.rows} points, {B6.min():.2f}–{B6.max():.2f} T, T median {np.median(r6.col("T_sample")):.3f} K, I median {np.median(I6)*1e9:.3f} nA, max |Rxx| {max(abs(R6)):.0f} Ω; max |I_TG| {max(abs(r6.col("k_2400_tg_curr")))*1e12:.0f} pA, max |I_BG| {max(abs(r6.col("k_2400_bg_curr")))*1e12:.0f} pA.')

sort6 = np.argsort(B6); bs6, rs6 = B6[sort6], R6[sort6]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4))
for lo in (1.5, 3.0, 4.0):
    f, a = sdh_fft(rs6[:, None], bs6, b_range=(lo, 10), nfft=4096, bg_degree=5, log=False)
    ax.plot(f, a[0]/max(a[0]), label=f'{lo:g}–10 T')
    ok = (f > 2) & (f < 55)
    p, _ = find_peaks(a[0, ok], prominence=max(a[0, ok])*0.08)
    ii = np.where(ok)[0][p]
    ii = ii[np.argsort(a[0, ii])[-4:]][::-1]
    print(f'FFT {lo:g}–10 T: ' + ', '.join(f'{f[j]:.1f} T' for j in ii))
ax.set_xlim(0, 55); ax.set_xlabel('frequency (T)'); ax.set_ylabel('normalized FFT magnitude'); ax.legend(); ax.set_title('data/6: window dependence (B-space polynomial removed)')
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()
try:
    print(sdh_onset(rs6, bs6, b_hi=10, b_lo=1.0, r_full_scale=50e-6/1e-8).summary())
except ValueError as exc:
    print('Onset unresolved:', exc)

**Read.** Strong field-dependent structure confirms a useful fan signal: the raw resistance reaches ~530 Ω at 10 T and neither lock-in reaches its full scale; the drain stays near 9.9 nA and gate currents remain below 0.13 nA. The 1/B spectrum depends strongly on the field window: a ~7 T component appears over 1.5–10 T; high-field windows emphasize ~30–33 T, with components near 14–23 T that may be harmonics. The onset routine reports the ~7 T track censored at its 1 T analysis edge. This single-density trace cannot distinguish independent ABAB pockets from harmonics or the two CNP regions identified in data/5; follow their density evolution in a fan.

The descending field sweep completed 10 to 0.3 T at (−0.2770, −0.4650) V. This density sits near the TG operating limit, and ridge B has a different local density. Plot raw channels before the 1/B read.

## HERA — Plan step 4: electron Landau fan at calibrated D = 0 (`landau-fan`)

> **05:24** · landau-fan: B 2–10 T (41 rows, 0.2 T); D\_A=0, n\_A +0.4…+3.2e12 (71 fast points); TG +0.181…+0.984 V, BG +0.128…+1.166 V; base T, Si 0 V, sr1 200 µV, 2.4 s/point · **ETA ~09:09** (≈3h45m)

Run 6 shows a ~7 T oscillation and window-dependent 14–33 T components at one density, while run 5 found two parallel CNP ridges separated by ~0.43×10¹² cm⁻²; a density-resolved fan is needed to distinguish independent branches from harmonics and the series mosaic. Sweep **n_A = +0.4…+3.2×10¹² cm⁻²** in 0.04×10¹² steps (TG +0.1814…+0.9836 V, BG +0.1282…+1.1661 V) along the run-5 calibrated D_A = 0 line, with B slow from 2 to 10 T in 0.2 T steps, starting from the handoff's ~0 T. The 2.4 s point dwell is 8× the measured 0.3 s lock-in time constant at 24 dB/oct; 200 µV sensitivity gives ~20 kΩ nominal R full scale at 10 nA for high-field headroom.

Before moving, the cell reads fresh sample/vaporizer thermometry, actual field, Si voltage, heater and magnet state, both gate-current NPLC settings, and lock-in settling settings; any mismatch stops it. **Coverage trade:** B < 2 T is omitted because runs 6–7 already sample it and the first purpose is to track resolvable high-field fan lines; the hole side is omitted because its D = 0 gate window is only ~1.27×10¹² cm⁻² and run 7 is a preview. Adding that side at this spacing would cost roughly another 1 h 15 m and would still share the same one longitudinal pair. Price uses data/5: 4158 points in 81 min with a 1 s dwell (~0.17 s read/point); 2911 points at 2.4 s dwell cost ~2 h 05 m, plus 10 T / 0.137 T/min = 73 min ramp floor, row turns, and margin. First-row checkpoint at B ≈ 2–2.4 T: look for rail, sustained >1 nA leakage, live T/current, and a changing Rxx trace; then assess fan trajectories at B ≈ 4, 6, and 8 T and stop a washout. End at 10 T and the high-n gate point so a refinement can ride the field down.

# Plan step 4: electron Landau fan on the run-5 D_A=0 calibration, B 2->10 T.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL_FAN = dict(c_tg=2.796e-3, c_bg=2.161e-3, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_fan = np.round(np.linspace(0.4, 3.2, 71), 5)  # 1e12 cm^-2, ridge A; spacing 0.04
B_fan = np.round(np.linspace(2.0, 10.0, 41), 4)
Vtg_fan, Vbg_fan = calc_gate_voltages(n_fan, np.zeros_like(n_fan), **CAL_FAN)
assert np.all((Vtg_fan >= TG_MIN) & (Vtg_fan <= TG_MAX))
assert np.all((Vbg_fan >= BG_MIN) & (Vbg_fan <= BG_MAX))
assert np.max(np.abs(B_fan)) <= B_SESSION_CAP
assert (TG_MIN, TG_MAX, BG_MIN, BG_MAX, SI_MIN, SI_MAX, B_SESSION_CAP, T_SESSION_CAP) == (-0.3, 1.0, -1.3, 2.0, -25.0, 25.0, 10.0, 100.0), 'SAFETIES constants differ from card'
print(f'fan geometry: {len(B_fan)} B rows {B_fan[0]:.1f}->{B_fan[-1]:.1f} T x {len(n_fan)} density points {n_fan[0]:.2f}->{n_fan[-1]:.2f}e12; gate endpoints TG {Vtg_fan[0]:+.4f}->{Vtg_fan[-1]:+.4f}, BG {Vbg_fan[0]:+.4f}->{Vbg_fan[-1]:+.4f} V')
print('n,D closure:', calc_nD(Vtg_fan[[0,-1]], Vbg_fan[[0,-1]], **CAL_FAN))

# Silent preconditions; all are reads of state this cell does not set.
assert_thermometry_live('T_sample', VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_sample'], max_age=15, max_period=12)
T0_fan, Tv0_fan, B0_fan, Si0_fan = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field(), k_si()
print(f'preconditions actual: T_sample={T0_fan:.3f} K (expected 1.0..1.5), T_vaporizer={Tv0_fan:.3f} K (base tracking); B={B0_fan:+.4f} T (expected |B|<0.02); Si={Si0_fan:+.4f} V (expected 0)')
print(f'preconditions actual: heaters sample/vaporizer ranges={heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (expected 0/0); PS={magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output={magnet.output_enabled()} (expected True/True); TG/BG NPLC={k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (expected 1/1)')
print(f'preconditions actual: sr0/sr1 tau={sr0.time_constant()}/{sr1.time_constant()} s, slopes={sr0.filter_slope()}/{sr1.filter_slope()} dB/oct (expected 0.3/0.3 s, 24/24); drive={sr1.amplitude()} V (expected 1)')
print(f'validator readback: TG {k_tg.volt.vals}, BG {k_bg.volt.vals}, Si smart {dc205.smart_voltage.vals}, Si raw {dc205.voltage.vals}, field {magnet.field.vals}, T sample/vap setpoint {heater.sample_setpoint.vals}/{heater.vaporizer_setpoint.vals}')
for param, limits in ((k_tg.volt, (TG_MIN, TG_MAX)), (k_bg.volt, (BG_MIN, BG_MAX)),
                      (dc205.smart_voltage, (SI_MIN, SI_MAX)), (dc205.voltage, (SI_MIN, SI_MAX)),
                      (magnet.field, (-B_SESSION_CAP, B_SESSION_CAP)),
                      (heater.sample_setpoint, (0, T_SESSION_CAP)),
                      (heater.vaporizer_setpoint, (0, T_SESSION_CAP))):
    assert (param.vals._min_value, param.vals._max_value) == limits, f'validator mismatch: {param.full_name}'
assert 1.0 <= T0_fan <= 1.5 and abs(Tv0_fan - T0_fan) < 0.5 and abs(B0_fan) < 0.02 and abs(Si0_fan) < 0.01
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert sr0.time_constant() == 0.3 and sr1.time_constant() == 0.3 and sr0.filter_slope() == 24 and sr1.filter_slope() == 24
assert abs(sr1.amplitude() - 1.0) < 1e-3

I_TRIP_FAN = 1e-9
SENS_FAN = 200e-6  # 20 kOhm nominal resistance full scale at 10 nA
SR0_SENS_FAN = sr0.sensitivity()
sr1.sensitivity(SENS_FAN)
print(f'sr1 sensitivity {sr1.sensitivity()} V; field ramp floor {(B_fan[-1]-B0_fan)/(1/7.3/60)/60:.1f} min')

mc_fan = dict(meas_config)
mc_fan['Si (V)'] = Si0_fan
mc_fan['sample_temperature:'] = T0_fan
mc_fan['comments'] = ('landau-fan electron: region-A D=0 n=+0.4..+3.2e12 (71), B=2..10 T (41), '
                      'run-5 ratio 0.773 and geometry-anchored c_tg, sr1 200 uV, 2.4 s fast dwell')
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc_fan)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment('B slow +2..+10 T, 0.2 T/row; co-swept TG/BG fast at D_A=0, n_A +0.4..+3.2e12 cm^-2, 0.04e12/point; '
              'TG +0.1814..+0.9836 V, BG +0.1282..+1.1661 V; Vsi=0; base T; run-5 c_bg/c_tg=0.773, c_tg=2.796 mF/m2 geometry prior; sr1 200 uV; fast_delay 2.4 s')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, float(Vbg_fan[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, float(Vtg_fan[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)

# Rows: time, B, TG, BG, T, I_TG, I_BG, sr0_X, sr0_P, sr1_X, sr1_P.
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot('time', T_sample)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P)

def fan_guard(station, data):
    B_now = float(data[1])
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    x1, x0 = abs(float(data[9])), abs(float(data[7]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP_FAN or i_bg > I_TRIP_FAN or x1 > 0.85*SENS_FAN or x0 > 0.85*SR0_SENS_FAN:
        print(f'FAN TRIP B={B_now:+.3f} T, n_A={float(n_fan[np.argmin(abs(Vtg_fan-float(data[2]))) ]):.2f}e12: |I_TG|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_BG|={i_bg:.3e} A, |sr1_X|={x1:.3e}, |sr0_X|={x0:.3e} V')
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

fan_result = s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_fan], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_fan, Vbg_fan], slow_delay=0.0, fast_delay=2.4)
print(f'fan run {fan_result.id}: B={magnet.field():+.4f} T, TG={k_tg.volt():+.4f} V, BG={k_bg.volt():+.4f} V, Si={k_si():+.4f} V')

## HERA — Step 3: SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 0 → 10 T

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Grid: uniform in B (blocking magnet) — 50 mT from 0 to 1 T (MR background only; LK at T_e ≈ 8 K kills m* = 0.06 below ~1.5 T), **10 mT from 1 to 10 T**; 921 points. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).
